          type: string
          minLength: 1

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1

          pattern: '.*\S.*'

          type: string

          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'

          title: Email address

          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

          title: Registration date
          description: >-

I implemented the `membershipNumber` field (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`, YY = last two digits of the registrationDate year) with minimal structural impact — **2 files touched, no method grown**:

I deliberately avoided adding a method to the large `Owner` entity (high surrounding complexity — every other method's CC would be paid for), placing the derivation instead in the small `OwnerMapper` interface where the surrounding context is cheap.
